predecessors.name: Jin (Korean state)
predecessors.text: Jinhan, whose rulers 'specifically claimed successorship over Jin state'

successors.name: Silla
successors.text: Silla's first Cliopatria shape, identical to Jinhan's

ledger.x: 91 BCE: the Jinhan confederacy of twelve statelets appears in the south-east, led by Saro.

certainty.note: A confederacy of twelve statelets with no frontier on any page; the Cliopatria outline is a block of the south-east.
